ability_extra.cpu_fallback_note: none observed; last_cpu_fallback empty means no fallback
ability_extra.freeze_note: gate only: counters at the first post-churn tick (hotTicks>=61); after the colours hold, identical content replays by fingerprint so rerecord should stay flat while skip keeps rising; null in manual because there is no freeze point
ability_extra.g_metrics_reason: R3b is a compositing-bits correctness window; measure cache fields are observed but not gated
ability_extra.impl_cache: clean boundaries replay and accumulate boundary_skip; content-changing dirty layers accumulate boundary_rerecord; after the gate freeze identical content replays by fingerprint (rr flat, skip rising), manual keeps content churn so rr rises in all phases
ability_extra.impl_correctness: main chain a->b->c->d (4 boundary layers), siblings s/s2, plain wrap with boundary pw, plain neg with no boundary; bits are bottom-up unions: root/body/wrap true, hot/neg false
ability_extra.impl_dirty: steady gate: hot/hotS colour churn for the first 60 ticks then hold final colours; manual steady: hot/hotS every tick, spike: a.Background + hotS2, recover: dHot; HUD is a separate RepaintBoundary band
ability_extra.impl_edge: 4-level main chain, 2 sibling boundaries, plain ancestor with boundary child (wrap->pw, bit true), plain no-boundary negative control (neg, bit false), 12 compositing chips, 16 grid cells, 17 scene labels, 10 legend rows; resize re-lays the shell
ability_extra.impl_fail: skip=0 or rerecord=0, boundary_count<3 or != scene, depth<4 or != structural depth, any compositing bit wrong, chips not set/stable, pixel probe mismatch, golden diff!=0, fps<55/p95>22, or present_policy!=full_paint -> FAIL
ability_extra.impl_visible: green/magenta chips show all 12 probed nodes; HUD skip/rr/phase; manual Steady animates hot/hotS, Spike flips a background + hotS2, Recover animates dHot; static layers stay; legend has colour swatches
ability_extra.rss_slope_note: rss_slope_valid=false because 8s < rss_warmup_sec=15; raw slope is startup-inclusive, not a leak conclusion
ability_extra.rss_slope_steady_note: rss_slope_steady_kb_per_min omitted when rss_slope_valid=false; an invalid steady slope must not claim a value (see wrgate TestBuildReport_ShortRunSlopeInvalidIsHonest)
